# Game Idea: Orbit Dodge

- HTML canvas game controlling a ship that orbits a planet.
- Asteroids spawn from screen edges; tap/press to thrust and dodge them.
- Collect floating energy orbs for points and fuel.
- **Lose condition:** collision with an asteroid or depletion of fuel.

1: // Simple Orbit Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Handle high‑DPI displays
8:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
9:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth * dpr;
10:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight * dpr;
11:   ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
12:   // generate static stars for background
13:   const stars = Array.from({length: 80}, () => ({
14:     x: Math.random() * canvas.clientWidth,
15:     y: Math.random() * canvas.clientHeight,
16:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
17:   }));
18:   // generate static stars for background
19:   const stars = Array.from({length: 80}, () => ({
20:     x: Math.random() * width,
21:     y: Math.random() * height,
22:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
23:   }));
24:   // ---- Game objects ----
25:   const planet = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, r: 30 };
26:   const ship = {
27:     angle: 0, // radians around planet
28:     radius: 80, // distance from planet centre
29:     size: 10,
30:     vx: 0,
31:     vy: 0,
32:     thrust: 0.2,
33:     friction: 0.99
34:   };
35:   const asteroids = [];
36:   const orbs = [];
37:   let fuel = 100;
38:   let score = 0;
39:   let gameOver = false;
40: 
41:   // ---- Helpers ----
42:   function rand(min, max) {
43:     return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
44:   }
45:   function spawnAsteroid() {
46:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0 top,1 right,2 bottom,3 left
47:     let x, y, dx, dy;
48:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
49:     switch (edge) {
50:       case 0: x = rand(0, width); y = -20; dx = rand(-1, 1); dy = speed; break;
51:       case 1: x = width + 20; y = rand(0, height); dx = -speed; dy = rand(-1, 1); break;
52:       case 2: x = rand(0, width); y = height + 20; dx = rand(-1, 1); dy = -speed; break;
53:       case 3: x = -20; y = rand(0, height); dx = speed; dy = rand(-1, 1); break;
54:     }
55:     const r = rand(10, 25);
56:     asteroids.push({ x, y, dx, dy, r });
57:   }
58:   function spawnOrb() {
59:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
60:     const radius = rand(60, 120);
61:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
62:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
63:     orbs.push({ x, y, r: 5, collected: false });
64:   }
65: 
66:   // ---- Audio setup ----
67:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
68:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
69:     // Ensure audio context is running (required by some browsers)
70:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
71:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
72:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
73:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
74:     osc.type = 'square';
75:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
76:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
77:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
78:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, now + 0.01);
79:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration / 1000);
80:     osc.start(now);
81:     osc.stop(now + duration / 1000);
82:   }
83:   function playThrust() { playTone(200, 100); }
84:   function playCollect() { playTone(600, 100); }
85:   function playExplosion() { playTone(80, 400); }
86: 
87:   // ---- Input ----
88:   let thrusting = false;
89:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { thrusting = true; playThrust(); });
90:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => thrusting = false);
91:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); thrusting = true; playThrust(); }, { passive: false });
92:   canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => thrusting = false);
93: 
94:   // ---- Game Loop ----
95:   function update(dt) {
96:     if (gameOver) return;
97:     // ship orbit update
98:     ship.angle += 0.01; // constant orbital speed
99:     // thrust changes velocity relative to ship direction (tangent)
100:     if (thrusting && fuel > 0) {
101:       const tx = Math.cos(ship.angle + Math.PI / 2) * ship.thrust;
102:       const ty = Math.sin(ship.angle + Math.PI / 2) * ship.thrust;
103:       ship.vx += tx;
104:       ship.vy += ty;
105:       fuel = Math.max(0, fuel - 0.1);
106:     }
107:     // apply friction
108:     ship.vx *= ship.friction;
109:     ship.vy *= ship.friction;
110:     // update ship position relative to planet
111:     const sx = Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius + ship.vx;
112:     const sy = Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius + ship.vy;
113:     ship.x = planet.x + sx;
114:     ship.y = planet.y + sy;
115: 
116:     // asteroids move
117:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
118:       const a = asteroids[i];
119:       a.x += a.dx; a.y += a.dy;
120:       // collision with ship
121:       const dx = a.x - ship.x, dy = a.y - ship.y;
122:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + ship.size) { gameOver = true; }
123:       // remove off‑screen
124:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > height + 50) {
125:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
126:       }
127:     }
128: 
129:     // orbs collection
130:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
131:       const o = orbs[i];
132:       if (!o.collected) {
133:         const d = Math.hypot(o.x - ship.x, o.y - ship.y);
134:         if (d < o.r + ship.size) {
135:           o.collected = true;
136:           score += 10;
137:           fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 20);
138:           orbs.splice(i, 1);
139:         }
140:       }
141:     }
142: 
143:     // spawn logic
144:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
145:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnOrb();
146:   }
147: 
148: function draw() {
149:     // clear with dark space background
150:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
151:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
152:     // draw stars
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
154:     stars.forEach(s => {
155:       ctx.beginPath();
156:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
157:       ctx.fill();
158:     });
159:     // planet with radial gradient (already set in draw)
160:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
161:       planet.x, planet.y, planet.r * 0.2,
162:       planet.x, planet.y, planet.r
163:     );
164:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
165:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
166:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
167:     ctx.beginPath();
168:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
169:     ctx.fill();
170:     // ship as triangle pointing forward
171:     ctx.save();
172:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
173:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle + Math.PI / 2);
174:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
175:     ctx.beginPath();
176:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.size);
177:     ctx.lineTo(ship.size * 0.8, ship.size);
178:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size * 0.8, ship.size);
179:     ctx.closePath();
180:     ctx.fill();
181:     ctx.restore();
182:     // asteroids with subtle gradient
183:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
184:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
185:         a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3,
186:         a.x, a.y, a.r
187:       );
188:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#b44');
189:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#511');
190:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
191:       ctx.beginPath();
192:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
193:       ctx.fill();
194:     });
195:     // orbs with glow effect
196:     orbs.forEach(o => {
197:       const orbGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
198:         o.x, o.y, 0,
199:         o.x, o.y, o.r
200:       );
201:       orbGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
202:       orbGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,165,0,0)');
203:       ctx.fillStyle = orbGrad;
204:       ctx.beginPath();
205:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
206:       ctx.fill();
207:     });
208:     // HUD
209:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
210:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
211:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
212:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
213:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(0)}`, 10, 40);
214:     if (gameOver) {
215:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
216:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
217:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
218:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
219:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
220:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
221:     }
222:   }
223:   }
224: 
225:   let last = performance.now();
226:   function loop(now) {
227:     const dt = now - last;
228:     last = now;
229:     update(dt);
230:     draw();
231:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
232:   }
233:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
234: })();

(End of file - total 234 lines)
</content>
